blocks.text: AI seems clever, but it isn't a wizard or a person. Let's see where its limits are.
Important: Claude is for adults (18+). So practise the Claude lessons together with a parent, who uses their own account.
Important: you may use ChatGPT from age 13 and only with a parent's permission. If you're younger, practise together with a parent.
Important: you need a parent's permission for Gemini. Younger children can use it only through a parent's Family Link account, where available.

items: Sometimes it makes up an answer and sounds sure – that's called a "hallucination".
It doesn't always know the latest news.
It can make mistakes in maths or facts.

blocks.text: AI can write kindly and sound like a friend, but it doesn't feel anything and doesn't know you like a real friend. If you're sad, have an argument or a problem, talk to a parent, teacher or another person you trust.
AI doesn't do your work for you
If AI writes your homework for you, you haven't learned anything – and teachers often notice. Use AI to explain things, not to copy.
Good rule: AI is like a smart helper, not someone who decides for you.
Explain 3 things AI isn't good at, with one example each. Write it for a 12-year-old.
